title: How We Work With AI
short_answer: Assistants can draft, flag, and prep. They never authorize work, never silently write Monday, and never post field briefs to #operations.
summary: AI is a sharp apprentice with no badge. Useful for checklists, photo hints, and morning prep drafts. You still decide.
plain_words: AI is a sharp apprentice with no badge. Useful for checklists, photo hints, and morning prep drafts. You still decide. If a tool ever claims it "already updated Job Check" or "already told the GC," treat that as a bug report, not a feature.
when_to_use: Before trusting any assistant suggestion on site
When using the Field Guide checklist coach
When evaluating roadmap assists (photo QC, morning prep, CO spotter)
prerequisites: Lead on site to confirm any suggestion before the crew treats it as direction

steps.title: No CO authority
steps.body: AI does not authorize extra work or replace a signed T&M / CO path.

steps.title: No Job Check writes
steps.body: AI does not advance Job Check or invent Monday column values.

steps.title: No #operations briefs
steps.body: AI does not post Morning Brief / huddle / route / prep to #operations — DM or side chat only, same as humans.

steps.title: No invented client scope
steps.body: AI does not invent scope, square footage, or 1-side/2-side language for client-facing text.

steps.title: Lead confirms
steps.body: Lead confirms any AI suggestion before the crew treats it as direction.

warnings.title: Assist judgment, never replace authorization
warnings.body: Tone for anything GVC builds: assist judgment, never replace authorization, never silent Monday writes, never channel-broadcast field briefs.

experts.summary: Checklist coach (LIVE): suggests next Field Manual steps for a stage — never writes Job Check. Photo QC coach (roadmap): hints at unfinished work — lead decides pass/fail. Morning prep agent (roadmap): drafts private brief from Monday + weather — Slack DM only. CO spotter (roadmap): flags verbal-add language — no auto-bill. Handoff open-questions coach (roadmap): surfaces clarifications before mobilize — ops accepts packet. Punch list drafter (roadmap): turns raking-light notes into a draft list — lead owns send.

quality_checks.prompt: No assistant advanced Job Check or claimed a Monday write
Lead confirmed direction before crew acted on an AI suggestion

common_mistakes.title: Treating coach as authority
common_mistakes.wrong: Crew moves because the coach suggested the next step
common_mistakes.right: Coach suggests; lead confirms; human taps Save on Job Check
common_mistakes.why: Coach is curated links, not authorization

common_mistakes.title: Believing "already updated"
common_mistakes.wrong: Trust a bot claim that Job Check or the GC was updated
common_mistakes.right: Report as bug; verify in portal yourself

provenance.note: GVC portal locked architecture (no auto-send Gmail; Monday as SoT; Morning Brief Slack rule) extended to AI assists. Checklist coach is curated Field Manual links only — no invented scope or Job Check writes. Other assists stay roadmap until prioritized.
